_comment: 5x proc-time multiplier at the locked slack lambda (0.008, agv07_single) -- interpolates between the proctime_multiplier_dial.json 4x (27-33% conventional-rule spread, MMUR censoring 75%/100%) and 6x (30-41% spread, MMUR censoring 94%/100%) results, aiming for a point with strong differentiation while LRT_MMUR doesn't hit total 100% collapse. minProcTime/maxProcTime scaled 5x from the 1x baseline (15/90 -> 75/450, mean ~262.5s, same min/max ratio preserved). Same 15000s duration as the rest of the proctime dial sweep for direct comparability. Run with --repeats 3 for real statistics (this is a locked config, not a fast dial-in pass). REQUIRES --baselinedrain true.
